public.text: The assertion that implementation fails mainly for lack of architectural accountability rather than technology may be directionally useful but is too broad.
public.suggestedRevision: Qualify the claim and recognise other major causes, including financing, leadership, workforce, adoption, procurement, legal barriers, infrastructure, data quality, and political economy.
